name: Flint Image
description: Four frontier-quality images from one prompt, via Gemini.

paragraphs: Flint Image is a cost-efficient image generation AI model developed by Eachlabs and powered by Gemini. It creates four different images from a single text prompt, giving users multiple visual directions without requiring four separate generation requests. This makes it easier to compare concepts, explore creative alternatives, and select the strongest output in less time.

Generating four images separately normally costs approximately $0.60. Flint Image produces four unique outputs for around $0.20, reducing generation costs by nearly 67%. For marketing teams, designers, creators, and developers who regularly need multiple visual options, Flint Image provides a more affordable and scalable approach to AI image generation.

Marketing and advertising concepts: Marketing teams can generate multiple visual directions for advertisements, landing pages, product launches, and campaign materials in a single request. Instead of creating one image at a time, teams receive four alternatives that can be reviewed together and used for faster creative testing.
